items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, Dave… [INTERVIEWEE] Sort of a little like that...

ctx.x: And he’d never crack a smile, he’d just, he’d never flinch, you know, he’d just do it [laughs] because he knew I was doing a number with him. In fact I don’t think we ever talked about it.
Sort of a little like that, did you read the – well I won't mention that on this tape ‘cause it’s really not germane. Did you read Oscar Peterson’s biography [The Will to Swing] that Gene Lees wrote?
